answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Proof of unique community garden plot tenancy. It requires a plot tended for four seasons at one garden, so the ridge of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a plot tended for four seasons at one garden is something they already have; the lagoon falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the crystal is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
